notes: Setup: ⚡ HouseRunner now makes your Google Sheet for you – sign in with Google, approve, done. No copying, no Apps Script, no Deploy (doing it by hand is still there)
Setup checks first whether your Google account needs the Apps Script switch on, and carries on by itself once it is
A step window follows along, with a picture of each click, and moves on by itself
After Google's approval you come back to setup, which checks your Sheet answers, shows a green ✅ and carries on
